title: Turkish-Style Beef Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, this recipe combines the flavors of Turkey with the heartiness of beef and spices.
instructions: Heat the fry oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the light brown sugar, Turkish red pepper flakes, and stir fry sauce to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Add the sliced leek to the skillet and cook until tender.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef mixture onto a tortilla and topping with shredded cheese, chopped cilantro, and a dollop of sour cream.
